notes.title: Final District Closed Playtest Update v0.35
notes.content:
[p][b]Final District Closed Playtest Update v0.35 Patch Notes![/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]New Stuff,[/b][/p][p]- New option to play story mode and horde mode offline.[/p][p]- New option to reduce particle effect quality.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes,[/b] [/p][p]- Fixed players not insta-killed when dying to lava.[/p][p]- Fixed some players not taking lava damage.[/p][p]- Fixed player collision in some areas.[/p][p]- Fixed client player attempting to heal over server authority.[/p][p]- Fixed some players not healed by heal drones.[/p][p]- Fixed laser cannon particles not disappearing.[/p][p]- Fixed some objects rendering even when no players are nearby.[/p][p]- Fixed gameplay modules for quickplay modes running while in story mode.[/p][p]- Fixed unwanted code overflow before game started causing crashes.[/p][p]- Fixed player bleed-out timer not resetting when revived by another player.[/p][p]- Fixed players getting damage feedback from toxic plants that have been killed.[/p][p]- Fixed care package getting stuck before landing in horde mode when more than one player is connected.[/p][p]- Fixed moving platforms inside storage facility causing excessive server load causing clients to experience extreme latency.[/p][p]- Fixed SMG sound artifacts when shooting for the first time.[/p][p]- Fixed lobby code not displayed for client players.
[/p][p][b]Changes,[/b] [/p][p]- Increased monolith charge bonus when killing an enemy.[/p][p]- Increased damage taken from lasers from 9 to 13.[/p][p]- Decreased Wrecking Ball damage taken with 2-4 players.[/p][p]- Significantly reduced performance load when weapons are fired.[/p][p]- Significantly reduced performance load when multiple players are firing weapons at the same time.[/p][p]- Significantly reduced performance for world loading.
[/p]

tags.feature: - New option to play story mode and horde mode offline.
- New option to reduce particle effect quality.

tags.bug: - Fixed players not insta-killed when dying to lava.
- Fixed some players not taking lava damage.
- Fixed player collision in some areas.
- Fixed client player attempting to heal over server authority.
- Fixed some players not healed by heal drones.
- Fixed laser cannon particles not disappearing.
- Fixed some objects rendering even when no players are nearby.
- Fixed gameplay modules for quickplay modes running while in story mode.
- Fixed unwanted code overflow before game started causing crashes.
- Fixed player bleed-out timer not resetting when revived by another player.
- Fixed players getting damage feedback from toxic plants that have been killed.
- Fixed care package getting stuck before landing in horde mode when more than one player is connected.
- Fixed moving platforms inside storage facility causing excessive server load causing clients to experience extreme latency.
- Fixed SMG sound artifacts when shooting for the first time.
- Fixed lobby code not displayed for client players.

tags.balance_change: - Increased monolith charge bonus when killing an enemy.
- Increased damage taken from lasers from 9 to 13.
- Decreased Wrecking Ball damage taken with 2-4 players.
- Significantly reduced performance load when weapons are fired.
- Significantly reduced performance load when multiple players are firing weapons at the same time.
- Significantly reduced performance for world loading.

notes.title: Final District Demo Update v0.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Demo Update v0.0.2 Patch Notes![/b]

[b]New Stuff,[/b]
- New option to delete story mode save files from the main menu.
- New selectable deathmatch map. (Storage Yard)
- New weapon mode, While the shotgun is equipped players can press [B] to switch bullet spread modes between focused and random.
- New sound to indicate incoming damage from other players.
- New interface for customizing character appearance.
- New buttons for selectable items in workbench.
- New bullet effect for terrain impacts.|

[b]Fixes,[/b]
- Fixed player weapon level not displayed properly when using workbenches.
- Fixed multiplayer body rotation not syncing correctly.
- Fixed player appearance not loading correctly in multiplayer games.
- Fixed access panels not working properly in quickplay games.
- Fixed gate particles not playing in quickplay modes.
- Fixed sideways air strafe speed not resetting after touching the ground.
- Fixed quest popup interfering with quickplay interface.
- Fixed deathmatch game results showing incorrect stats.
- Fixed characters from other players shaking excessively while moving fast.
- Fixed main menu audio muted when exiting game while knocked down.

[b]Changes,[/b]
- Modified some areas to storage yard map.
- Modified some areas to water station map.
- Changed feedback sound for critical hits.
- Increased gun empty sound.
- Increased gun near empty sound.
- Players can now gain 'fire' by shooting other players in deathmatch mode.
- Player hips and legs will now look into the direction that they are moving.
- Improved general animation quality for other players.
- Players can no longer customize character appearance in-game.
- Main menu framerate fixed at 144 to avoid overworking hardware.
- Improved workbench interface.

notes.title: Final District Closed Beta Update v0.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Closed Beta Update v0.0.1 Patch Notes![/b]

[b]New Stuff,[/b]
- New damage indicator that will ping the direction of incoming damage for 2 seconds.
- New bullet trails for enemy players.
- Added sideways air strafing.
- Players will now respawn in dropships when playing deathmatch.
- Added new props and cover for deathmatch games.

[b]Fixes,[/b]
- Fixed ammo not reloaded on respawn.
- Fixed footstep sounds from other players not activating.
- Fixed players could cause damage to enemies while health was below 0.
- Fixed deathmatch maps not loading properly.
- Fixed player damage, kills and points not resetting at the end of quickplay games.
- Fixed cursor locked for clients on statistic screens.
- Fixed statistic screen not showing for all clients at the end of quickplay games.
- Basic optimization improvements.

[b]Changes,[/b]
- Reduced ability and grenade cooldown after respawning.
- Increased gunshot volume from other players.
- Increased gunshot sound distance from other players.
- Increased footstep volume from other players.
- Increased footstep sound distance from other players.
- Increased slide sound distance from other players.
- Players can no longer change directions sideways while sliding.
- Players will now lose respawn immunity when firing a weapon.
- Players now gain 250 points per kill during deathmatch games.
- Players no longer have infinite points during deathmatch games.
